heading: Ex-Prathipadu YSRCP MLA, aides join JSP
author: The Hindu Bureau
paragraphs: Former Prathipadu YSRCP MLA Varupula Subba Rao, former Peddapuram Municipal Vice Chairman Nekkanti Sai Prasad and former Samarlakota Municipal Chairperson Gangireddy Aruna on Monday joined the Jana Sena Party in the presence of party president and Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan.
The two key YSRCP leaders have also enabled joining of their cadre in the Jana Sena Party from the Assembly segments of Peddapuram, Prathipadu and Jaggampeta in Kakinada District.
Welcoming the YSRCP leaders and the cadre into the party, Mr. Pawan Kalyan has asked them to strive to strengthen the party in the Kakinada District.
